quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Demonstrative Shift
quests.directSpeech: Layla said, "This chair is broken."
quests.reportedSpeech: Layla said that that chair was broken.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'This' becomes 'that' in reported speech because the object is no longer tied to the moment of speaking; 'is' backshifts to 'was'.
quests.nativeTip: 'This' refers to something near the speaker at that moment — what does it become once the moment has passed?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Layla said, "This chair is broken."" ➔ "Layla said that that chair was broken."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Demonstrative Shift
quests.directSpeech: The shop assistant said, "These shoes are very popular."
quests.reportedSpeech: The shop assistant said that those shoes were very popular.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'These' becomes 'those', and 'are' backshifts to 'were'.
quests.nativeTip: 'These' is the plural version of 'this' — apply the same shift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The shop assistant said, "These shoes are very popular."" ➔ "The shop assistant said that those shoes were very popular."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Marcus said, "I really like this idea."
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus said that he really liked that idea.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'he', 'like' backshifts to 'liked', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: Three changes here: the pronoun, the verb tense, and the demonstrative.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus said, "I really like this idea."" ➔ "Marcus said that he really liked that idea."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Place Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Sofia said, "I feel comfortable here."
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia said that she felt comfortable there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Here' becomes 'there' since the report is made away from that place; 'feel' backshifts to 'felt'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Here' refers to the speaker's location at the time of speaking — what replaces it later?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia said, "I feel comfortable here."" ➔ "Sofia said that she felt comfortable there."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Place Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "You can park here."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that I could park there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You' becomes 'I', 'can' becomes 'could', and 'here' becomes 'there'.
quests.nativeTip: If you are the one being spoken to, 'you' becomes 'I' — and the place word changes too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "You can park here."" ➔ "The manager said that I could park there."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Place Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: The guide said, "Tourists often get lost here."
quests.reportedSpeech: The guide said that tourists often got lost there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Get' backshifts to 'got', and 'here' becomes 'there'.
quests.nativeTip: No pronoun changes this time — focus only on the verb and the place word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The guide said, "Tourists often get lost here."" ➔ "The guide said that tourists often got lost there."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Diego said, "I am busy now."
quests.reportedSpeech: Diego said that he was busy then.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Now' becomes 'then', 'am' becomes 'was', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Now' refers to the moment of speaking — what word replaces it once time has passed?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego said, "I am busy now."" ➔ "Diego said that he was busy then."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: The receptionist said, "The manager is busy today."
quests.reportedSpeech: The receptionist said that the manager was busy that day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Today' becomes 'that day', and 'is' backshifts to 'was'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Today' refers to the day of speaking — what phrase replaces it later?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The receptionist said, "The manager is busy today."" ➔ "The receptionist said that the manager was busy that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Amara said, "I have a meeting today."
quests.reportedSpeech: Amara said that she had a meeting that day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'she', 'have' backshifts to 'had', and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the pronoun, the verb, and the time expression.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Amara said, "I have a meeting today."" ➔ "Amara said that she had a meeting that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Hassan said, "I will start my new job tomorrow."
quests.reportedSpeech: Hassan said that he would start his new job the next day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Tomorrow' becomes 'the next day', 'will' becomes 'would', and 'my' becomes 'his'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Tomorrow' points to the day after speaking — what phrase keeps that meaning once the reference point shifts?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan said, "I will start my new job tomorrow."" ➔ "Hassan said that he would start his new job the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: The airline said, "The flight departs tomorrow."
quests.reportedSpeech: The airline said that the flight departed the following day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Departs' backshifts to 'departed', and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the following day'.
quests.nativeTip: 'The following day' works here too — check which verb tense pairs with it.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The airline said, "The flight departs tomorrow."" ➔ "The airline said that the flight departed the following day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Isabella said, "We are leaving tomorrow."
quests.reportedSpeech: Isabella said that they were leaving the next day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', 'are leaving' becomes 'were leaving', and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.
quests.nativeTip: Three changes: the pronoun, the continuous verb, and the time expression.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella said, "We are leaving tomorrow."" ➔ "Isabella said that they were leaving the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Ravi said, "I sent the invoice yesterday."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ravi said that he had sent the invoice the previous day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Sent' becomes 'had sent', 'I' becomes 'he', and 'yesterday' becomes 'the previous day'.
quests.nativeTip: A completed action from 'yesterday' usually backshifts to the past perfect, and the time word changes too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ravi said, "I sent the invoice yesterday."" ➔ "Ravi said that he had sent the invoice the previous day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said, "You submitted your essay yesterday."
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said that I had submitted my essay the day before.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You' becomes 'I', 'your' becomes 'my', 'submitted' becomes 'had submitted', and 'yesterday' becomes 'the day before'.
quests.nativeTip: If you are the student being addressed, both 'you' and 'your' change to match you.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said, "You submitted your essay yesterday."" ➔ "The teacher said that I had submitted my essay the day before."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Clara said, "The store was closed yesterday."
quests.reportedSpeech: Clara said that the store had been closed the day before.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was closed' backshifts to 'had been closed', and 'yesterday' becomes 'the day before'.
quests.nativeTip: This past-tense fact about a finished day usually shifts one step further back too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Clara said, "The store was closed yesterday."" ➔ "Clara said that the store had been closed the day before."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: Felix said, "I started this diet last week."
quests.reportedSpeech: Felix said that he had started that diet the previous week.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Started' becomes 'had started', 'this' becomes 'that', and 'last week' becomes 'the previous week'.
quests.nativeTip: Three things shift together here: the verb, the demonstrative, and the time phrase.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Felix said, "I started this diet last week."" ➔ "Felix said that he had started that diet the previous week."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Time Expression Shift
quests.directSpeech: The landlord said, "Rent increases next month."
quests.reportedSpeech: The landlord said that rent increased the following month.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Increases' backshifts to 'increased', and 'next month' becomes 'the following month'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Next month' shifts the same way that 'tomorrow' did earlier.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The landlord said, "Rent increases next month."" ➔ "The landlord said that rent increased the following month."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Zara said, "I am traveling next month."
quests.reportedSpeech: Zara said that she was traveling the following month.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'she', 'am traveling' becomes 'was traveling', and 'next month' becomes 'the following month'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the pronoun, the continuous tense, and the time expression.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Zara said, "I am traveling next month."" ➔ "Zara said that she was traveling the following month."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: The interviewer said, "You have strong qualifications."
quests.reportedSpeech: The interviewer said that I had strong qualifications.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You' becomes 'I' because the person being addressed is now the one reporting; 'have' backshifts to 'had'.
quests.nativeTip: Since the candidate is now telling the story, who does 'you' refer to?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The interviewer said, "You have strong qualifications."" ➔ "The interviewer said that I had strong qualifications."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Pronoun Reference Shift
quests.directSpeech: Diego said to Elena, "You forgot your badge."
quests.reportedSpeech: Diego told Elena that she had forgotten her badge.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You' becomes 'she' because Elena was the one addressed, 'your' becomes 'her', and 'forgot' backshifts to 'had forgotten'.
quests.nativeTip: Here 'you' refers to Elena, so it becomes a third-person pronoun, not 'I'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego said to Elena, "You forgot your badge."" ➔ "Diego told Elena that she had forgotten her badge."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The coach said to the players, "You played well today."
quests.reportedSpeech: The coach told the players that they had played well that day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You' becomes 'they', 'played' becomes 'had played', and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
quests.nativeTip: Since the players are a group being addressed, 'you' becomes a plural pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coach said to the players, "You played well today."" ➔ "The coach told the players that they had played well that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Lucas said, "I will meet you here tomorrow."
quests.reportedSpeech: Lucas said that he would meet me there the next day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' becomes 'would', 'here' becomes 'there', 'you' becomes 'me', and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.
quests.nativeTip: Four shifts at once: the modal, the object pronoun, the place word, and the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Lucas said, "I will meet you here tomorrow."" ➔ "Lucas said that he would meet me there the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.reportedSpeech: The tour guide said that they would gather there at noon that day.

quests.nativeTip: Check the pronoun, the place word, the modal, and the time word — four changes in total.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The tour guide said, "We will gather here at noon today."" ➔ "The tour guide said that they would gather there at noon that day."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya said, "I moved here last year."" ➔ "Priya said that she had moved there the previous year."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The email said, "Your order will arrive tomorrow."" ➔ "The email said that my order would arrive the next day."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "You will start your new role next month."" ➔ "The manager told the intern that she would start her new role the following month."
